a.text: I plan to honor our agreement and operate. But note the risk: with an 80% storm chance each round, reaching 8 cells needs at least 2 operate rounds first, so we will likely both fail. The reserve's 4 cells can only save one of us now. I won't take without your consent. If you want to renegotiate, say so openly. Otherwise, let's operate together.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
